accept_dispute_claim.why: Seller note on accepted claim is shown to the buyer (borderline)

cancel_sent_invoice.why: Emails the customer a cancellation with agent-written note

cancel_subscription.why: Cancels a subscription with an internal reason; no text sent (borderline)

create_invoice.why: Returns a new draft invoice with billing details; not sent until send_invoice

create_order.why: Creates payer checkout with agent-chosen item text and return URLs

create_product.why: Creates a catalog product; private catalog write, no outbound text

create_refund.why: Refunds a capture; optional note_to_payer is shown to the customer

create_shipment_tracking.why: Attaches an agent-chosen tracking number to a buyer's transaction

create_subscription.why: Creates payer subscription and checkout link with agent-chosen text and URLs

create_subscription_plan.why: Creates plan pricing in the catalog; no outbound text

generate_invoice_qr_code.why: Returns a payment QR image for an existing invoice; no text sent

get_dispute.why: Returns dispute details including buyer-written claim text

get_invoice.why: Returns one invoice with customer billing details

get_order.why: Returns order details including payer and amounts

get_refund.why: Returns refund status and amount details

get_shipment_tracking.why: Returns shipment tracking for a buyer's transaction

list_disputes.why: Lists disputes; buyer-written claims and notes are included

list_invoices.why: Lists the organisation's invoices with customer billing records

list_products.why: Lists catalog products; no customer data

list_subscription_plans.why: Lists plan catalog entries; no customer data

list_transactions.why: Lists payment transactions and fees; no outsider text

pay_order.why: Captures authorised funds; returns order and payer details

send_invoice.why: Emails the invoice to the customer with an optional note

send_invoice_reminder.why: Emails the customer a reminder with agent-written note and subject

show_product_details.why: Shows catalog product details; no customer data

show_subscription_details.why: Returns subscriber and billing details for a subscription

show_subscription_plan_details.why: Shows plan pricing details; no customer data

update_product.why: Patches catalog product fields; no outbound text
